_doc: Ceramic templates (MT-043). Quads are normalized [0..1] coordinates on the base bitmap, top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Blend mode for ceramic is NORMAL @ 0.92 alpha so the print sits ON the glaze rather than under it. Templates not listed here fall back to the category default (ceramic: NORMAL @ 0.90, 12% inset).

_authoring_status_legend.default_estimate: Surface-default quad; MUST be refined per-template on-device before release.
_authoring_status_legend.authored: Manually authored from the actual template image; verified visually.
_authoring_status_legend.masked: Authored + has matching <id>.mask.png for ceramic-region integration.

_surface_defaults.plate: Circular dinner-plate centre, NORMAL @ 0.92, 18% inset from rim. Use authored quads in seed set; the centre disc is the safe zone.
_surface_defaults.tile: Square decorative tile face, NORMAL @ 0.94, 8% inset for grout line. Quads track the tile bevel; do not bleed into the grout.
_surface_defaults.mug: Cylindrical mug body, NORMAL @ 0.88, follows mug curvature. The quad must wrap the visible front face only; back-of-mug placement is unsupported on-device.
